concerns.text: T005 (entropy.py) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T006 (parser.py) to produce 'data/processed/metrics_with_moves.csv'. A task cannot be parallel-safe if it requires the output of another task to exist first. The [P] tag is semantically incorrect here.

T007c (proxy_extractor.py) is marked [P] but depends on T014a (splitter.py) to produce 'validation_set_ids.json'. The task description explicitly states it must 'Read validation_set_ids.json... to filter the master file'. This is a hard sequential dependency, making the [P] tag invalid.

T008b (Generate Ground Truth Labels - Validation) is marked [P] but depends on T014a (splitter.py) to produce 'validation_set.csv'. The task description states 'Input: validation_set.csv (from T014a)'. Parallel execution is impossible without the split artifact.

T017 (Execute Dynamic Simulation) is marked [P] but depends on T015 (Dynamic Logic) and T016 (Token Budget). T015 and T016 are implementation tasks that must complete before the simulation can run. Marking T017 as [P] implies it can run concurrently with T015/T016, which violates the producer-consumer flow.

T019 (Static Baseline) and T020 (Random Baseline) are marked [P] but depend on T018 (engine_runner.py). While T019 and T020 can run in parallel *with each other*, they cannot run in parallel with T018 if T018 is an implementation task. If T018 is 'complete' (checked), then T019/T020 are safe, but the [P] tag on T019/T020 in the context of the whole Phase 3 block is misleading if T018 is not yet done. However, T018 is marked [X] (complete), so this is a minor semantic nit, but T017's [P] tag is a hard violation.
T024a (Divergence Detection) is marked [P] but depends on T017 and T019. T017 and T019 are simulation tasks. T024a cannot run until both simulations are complete. The [P] tag is invalid.
T025 (Statistical Testing) is marked [P] but depends on T024a (Divergence) and T021 (Aggregation). It cannot run in parallel with its inputs. The [P] tag is invalid.
T028 (Final Report) is marked [P] but depends on T025 and T022a. It is the final aggregation step and cannot be parallel with its dependencies. The [P] tag is invalid.

The section 'Phase 2b: Sequential Dependencies' lists T007c, T008, T008b, T008c_1/2/3, T014, T009. However, T008c_1/2/3 are marked [P] in the list but depend on T008. T008c_1/2/3 should not be [P] relative to T008. Also, T014 depends on T007c and T008b, so it cannot be [P] relative to them.
